spec.description: BackupDRRestoreVerificationPlanSpec defines the desired state of BackupDRRestoreVerificationPlan

description.description:
Optional. The description of the `RestoreVerificationPlan` resource.

 The description allows for additional details about
 `RestoreVerificationPlan` and its use cases to be provided. An example
 description is the following: "This is a restore verification plan that
 performs a daily verification and cleans up the resources immediately
 after." The description must be at most 2048 characters.

failureCleanupRule.description: Optional. The cleanup rule to apply if the restore verification fails.

cleanupDelay.description: Optional. Duration after restore finishes when cleanup triggers. Delay must be non-negative and at most 30 days (2592000 seconds).

skipCleanup.description: Optional. If set to true, the restored resource will not be cleaned up.

location.description: The location that this resource belongs to.

projectRef.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The BackupDRRestoreVerificationPlan name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

schedule.description:
Required. Describes the schedule on which the restore verification will be
 executed.

 The schedule is specified as a
 [Crontab](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron#Overview) string.

successCleanupRule.description: Optional. The cleanup rule to apply if the restore verification succeeds.

cleanupDelay.description: Optional. Duration after restore finishes when cleanup triggers. Delay must be non-negative and at most 30 days (2592000 seconds).

skipCleanup.description: Optional. If set to true, the restored resource will not be cleaned up.

timeZone.description: Optional. Specifies the time zone to be used in interpreting [schedule][google.cloud.backupdr.v1.RestoreVerificationPlan.schedule]. The value of this field must be a time zone name from the [tz database](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tz_database), like "America/New_York" or "UTC". Defaults to `UTC` if not specified.
